query: Create a user story: on the Practitioner Participation (PAR) form, when a Credentialing Specialist enters a primary practice location whose effective date is in the future, the system should warn them before submit and still allow submission. Priority P1.
expected_behavior: Asks the vertical first and clarifying questions (via structured multiple-choice) before generating any story content
Verifies the PAR OmniScript / related IPs exist using code-review-graph tools first (semantic_search_nodes / query_graph), not Grep, and does not invent component names
Uses a concrete business-role persona 'Credentialing Specialist' — never 'user' or 'business user'
Acceptance Criteria use Pattern A (Given/When/Then), three explicit lines, one When each, at least one happy path and one edge case (future-dated) as separate ACs
No Apex class names, IP version/step numbers, SOQL, or API field names appear inside any Given/When/Then/And line
Includes a '## Technical Implementation (high-level)' section after the ACs that names components and cross-references the AC numbers
Includes Definition of done checklist and an Estimated Effort table with S/M/L/XL/XXL sizing labelled AI-estimated
Proposes saving the story under requirements/<PascalCase>.md
